fixtureAdjustments: Initial production GRA placement was unschedulable due to reserved CPU; only disposable fixtures moved to spare capacity in VIN/HIL.

The initial canary run hit HTTP 400 responses from its temporary TLS audit proxy. The Scaleway clock was about 92 seconds behind; restarting only the fixture proxy after certificate validity cleared the responses. This is consistent with cached certificate-validation state, not a confirmed root cause. Full rerun passed. Production fixture proxy was also restarted before its run.
cleanup: All disposable fixture resources removed after qualification; private host routes/timers and reservations retained. Private-bound throughput listeners self-terminated; iperf3 daemons disabled and inactive.
